title: Email
intro: Real messages, delivery records and customer replies in one place.
enabled_note: Sending is enabled. The queue is checked every five minutes after scheduler setup.
paused_note: Sending is paused. Queued messages stay here until sending is enabled.
setup_help: DNS verification, a server API key and a signed webhook must be configured. Keys stay on the server.
contact_help: Messages use the customer email saved in the site settings. Internal login names are not customer mailboxes.
inbox_note: Incoming emails appear after receiving DNS and webhook setup.
delivery_note: Accepted means the provider received the email. Delivered requires a signed delivery event. It does not prove the customer read it.
review_note: Confirm the recipient and content. Site-ready messages are your decision after checking the site.
queued_note: Saved to the queue. Delivery has not been confirmed yet.
contact_missing: Add the real customer email in the site settings first.
error: The action could not be confirmed. Check the queue before trying again.
processed: Queue checked. Current delivery states are shown below.
no_text: This message has no plain text. Open Resend to inspect its original content.
truncated: The message is shortened here. Inspect the original in Resend.
attachment_note: Attachments remain in Resend and are not downloaded by this panel.
